executive_deck_slides.title: International DTC Subscriber Growth & Forecast Performance
executive_deck_slides.headline_takeaway: Active international base reached 5,295.1K subscribers across 12 EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and NAM-Intl markets; walk-forward driver model achieved 0.95% holdout MAPE (66.8% error reduction vs. 2.85% seasonal baseline).

executive_deck_slides.title: Acquisition, Retention & Bundle Monetization Drivers
executive_deck_slides.headline_takeaway: Annual plan commitments lowered churn from 42.7% (month-to-month) to 11.3%, while dual-service streaming bundles retained 70.6% of accounts at higher ARPU.

executive_deck_slides.title: Wholesale Partnership Structuring & Retail Cannibalization Guardrails
executive_deck_slides.headline_takeaway: Recommended 6_Q4_Tentpole_Fenced_Ad_Hybrid timed for Q4 guidance alignment delivers +306.1K net incremental subscribers and +$28.46M incremental operating income, cutting retail cannibalization from 41.0% (unfenced) down to 11.0% (-30.0 pp).
